title: Eternals #8 Marvel May 1986 Limited Series Party Crashers Sal Buscema Pollard
condition_description: Front cover bright. Back cover has chipping near the top edge and scuffing; small tear on the inside cover page near the edge. See close-ups.
description:
The Eternals #8 (of 12) (Marvel, May 1986), Vol. 2 limited series. "Party Crashers!" with Ikaris vs. the Skrulls. Written by Peter B. Gillis, art by Sal Buscema, cover by Keith Pollard. Marvel 25th Anniversary cover frame. 75c cover price.

Back cover: Scott Adams Questprobe / Marvel Adventure computer games ad.

Condition: front cover bright; chipping near the top edge of the back cover with scuffing, and a small tear on the inside cover page near the edge (see close-ups).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
